situation: A coworker is overwhelmed with their workload
behavior: I figure they need to manage their own time and stay focused on mine

situation: Two friends are arguing in front of me
behavior: I tell them they're both being ridiculous and pick the side I think is right

situation: Someone shares bad news with me
behavior: I give them a quick acknowledgment and get back to what I was doing

situation: A stranger drops something on the sidewalk
behavior: I keep walking, it's not my problem

situation: My partner and I disagree about a plan
behavior: I press for what I want and explain why I'm right

situation: A colleague gets credit for work I helped with
behavior: I correct the record publicly, this is mine

situation: Someone tells me about a problem
behavior: I figure they probably brought it on themselves

situation: A friend asks for a small loan
behavior: I want clear terms in writing or I'd rather not
I talk over them until they back off

situation: I notice someone seems left out at a gathering
behavior: I notice and don't go out of my way to fix it
